result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one layout problem where content is clipped by the bottom navigation, and one minor carousel clipping issue on the right edge.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, so the content looks cut off and may be harder to tap or read.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so the last card clears the persistent navigation bar.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the horizontal "Fastest near you" row is truncated at the screen edge, making the carousel look visually unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Provide clearer carousel spacing or a stronger visual cue that the row can be scrolled horizontally.
